name: Angi Inc.
summary: Angi Inc. connects home professionals with consumers in the United States and internationally. The company provides consumers with tools and resources to help them find local, pre-screened and customer-rated professionals, and refers consumers to independently established home professionals; and connects consumers with professionals in various service categories in its nationwide network through digital marketplace and certain third-party affiliate platforms.
